messages:
Aisha Patel: Heads-up — ChannelX invoice CX-9876 looks like it double-counted reassigned seats for Apr. Total credit requested ~ $72,450. s3 link with diff CSV: s3://redwood-billing/channelx/apr-discrepancy.csv
Tom Nguyen: Can you drop the mapping and delta by SKU? need GL code + fiscal period. :eyes:
Marcos (ChannelX): Sorry about that — saw a migration on Apr 4 that triggered seat duplications on our side. Uploading partner reconciliation now.
Marcos (ChannelX): https://files.channelx.com/redwood/channelx-recon-apr.pdf
Sophie (Acct Mgmt): If it's >$50k we need legal sign-off + management approval. @Jin legal FYI.
billing-bot: Invoice CX-9876 imported (2024-04-30) — amount $1,234,567 — detected variance with usage report.
Leo (Finance Ops): Aisha — can we net this as a credit memo against May payout? Also need per-sku breakdown and unit rates.
Aisha Patel: Prefer to credit now since partner payout is next week, but can net if preferred by accounting. Attached the delta CSV (s3 link above).
Tom Nguyen: SQL I used to generate the delta:
```
SELECT sku, sum(charged_seats) as charged, sum(actual_seats) as actual, sum(charged_seats-actual_seats) as delta
FROM billing.partner_usage
WHERE partner_id='channelx' AND period='2024-04'
GROUP BY sku;
```
Tom Nguyen: GL code to use: 4320.05 (Partner Credits) — fiscal period 2024-04
Jin (Legal): I'll review the partner-signed reconciliation and confirm standard credit memo terms. Need partner acceptance email or signature.
Marcos (ChannelX): Partner signed the recon. Upload: https://files.channelx.com/redwood/signed-recon-apr.pdf
Sophie (Acct Mgmt): Management approval granted — Sophie ok to proceed. @Aisha please create the credit memo and loop in accounting.
Aisha Patel: Creating credit memo now. Posting will be pending legal hold clearance.
billing-bot: Created credit memo CM-2024-521 for $72,450 — status: pending_posting (awaiting legal clearance)
Jin (Legal): Reviewed — no special covenants, legal clears posting. Good to post.
Leo (Finance Ops): Posting credit memo today and netting against May payout per accounting preference.
Aisha Patel: Thanks all. I'll update the partner ledger and confirm when posted. :white_check_mark:
